free()?

optional free(): void;

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/webgpu-widget.ts:65

wasm-bindgen free() — drops the boxed struct AND unregisters the FinalizationRegistry entry, so the object never re-enters __wbg_*_free at GC time (the registry path is where a stale glue/wasm pair traps memory access out of bounds — the glue's free shim walks the struct layout compiled into ITS wasm, and a hot-swapped artifact pair makes that read land off the heap). Destroy calls it so the free happens deterministically while the artifact pair that built the object is still the live one.

void
